name: beyond_update_document
description: Update a working-stage shared project document in TB_DOCUMENT. ACTOR_TYPE is always AI, and actor_name must identify the LLM model name and version.

doc_id.description: Document ID to update, such as doc_xxx.

doc_content.description: Replacement full markdown content. Required unless file_name is being updated by itself.

actor_name.description: LLM model name and version, such as GPT-5 Codex 2026-08-12 or the exact MCP client model identifier.

include_json_content.description: When false, omit duplicated JSON from text content and rely on structuredContent.
